project_type: Python async trading signal bot using ib_insync for IB Gateway connectivity
build_system: pip with requirements.txt, no Makefile or Dockerfile
test_framework: pytest with conftest.py fixtures in tests/ directory
verification_instructions: 1. Install deps: pip install -r requirements.txt. 2. Run tests: python3 -m pytest tests/ -v. 3. Import check: python3 -c 'import orderflow'
setup_instructions: pip install -r requirements.txt (OPEN_INTERNET mode available for package installs)
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET - full network access. Python 3.9.25 available at /usr/bin/python3. No IB Gateway running (cannot do live integration tests). Tests must mock ib_insync connections.
contribution_requirements: Signal-only system. NEVER place orders or execute trades. Read-only API mode. User decides all risk/sizing. Modular code structure matching existing nas100bot patterns.
key_patterns: Existing project uses: YAML config with config.example.yaml, python-telegram-bot async API with sync wrapper, dataclass-based signal objects, pytest with fixtures in conftest.py, logging with rotating file handler, pytz for US/Eastern timezone handling, argparse for CLI. Telegram module uses HTML parse mode.
directory_structure: hii/ (repo root): nas100bot/ (daily signal bot), journal/ (trade journal), tests/ (pytest tests), config.example.yaml, requirements.txt, README.md. New orderflow/ directory will be added alongside these.
